title: Keep HTTP; WASM for Pure Compute Only
content: Architecture decision: HTTP is the correct seam between stateful Rust engine (fs, threads, SQLite, ONNX) and stateless browser. wm-core doesn't compile to wasm32. WASM is only for pure-compute extensions that are chatty over HTTP (layout, re-ranking, parsing). Each WASM addition must delete its HTTP predecessor. Full reference: @wiki/decisions/http-wasm-seam
